candidates.statement: Order service postgres connection pool is exhausted (size 5, idle 0), causing save_order to fail with DependencyUnavailable; order returns 503 and gateway checkout returns 502 after ~2s.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show pool size 5 with 0 idle at failure time, but no pool saturation time series or postgres-side metrics were admitted to confirm exhaustion versus postgres unavailability.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s correlate with order-service 503s on /v1/orders; traces show postgres.save_order failing with DependencyUnavailable while pool size=5 and idle=0, and order metrics show 13.7 503s/min on v1.0.0. Deployment record only establishes version facts, not causation. Pool exhaustion is the best-supported bounded candidate.
